{{Quote|I need you to find the Canopy bandit's camp and see if you can find my friends there.|[[Lisum]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
The '''Canopy bandit's camp''' was located on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the base of the group of criminals known as the [[Canopy bandits]].

==Description==
The camp was located in the region of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], on the planet Kashyyyk. It was situated on a cliff overlooking a river next to the [[Bolotaur Beach]]. The camp consisted of few small tents and structures.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

==History==
{{Quote|So, did you find my friends? They are alright...aren't they?''"<br />"''I am sorry. I found their bodies in the Canopy camp.|A spacer, to Lisum|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
The Canopy bandit's camp was inhabited by the [[Canopy bandits]], a vicious band of criminals, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. One of their leaders, [[Nworb Yorel|Big Nworb Yorel the Bad]], was also living in the camp.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

[[File:Kashyyyk_dead_researchers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The corpses of the dead researchers in the Canopy bandit's camp.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Canopy bandits attacked a [[Research Camp|research camp]] located in the wilderness of Kashyyyk, north of Kachirho. The criminals captured the scientists working there and brought them captive to their camp. The Canopy bandits usually kidnapped people for ransom but, for some reason, they executed all the researchers this time, including [[Jillian]], [[Bathoz]] and [[Rengar]]. A short time later, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] discovered the destroyed research camp. While investigating the camp site, a spacer was contacted over the radio by another researcher, [[Lisum]], who was trying to liaise with his friends. The spacer accepted to help to uncover the researchers' fate and the adventurers therefore searched the camp for clues. When one of the spacers found the word "Canopy" written on a dented drum, Lisum immediately understood that the scientists had been taken by the Canopy bandits. He thus asked the spacers to find the Canopy bandit's camp where the researchers where likely held captive. The adventurers explored the area and finally found the bandit's lair. However, it was already too late and they only found the corpses of the dead scientists in the camp.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Canopy bandit's camp appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Canopy bandit's camp was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TMR" />
